title: Reproduce: w*(3;5) <= 76 (the 2007 table prints >= 75)
statement: Every colouring of 1..76 with 5 colours contains x, x+d, x+2d (d >= 1) whose colours c1, c2, c3 satisfy c1 + c3 = 2*c2. (The matching lower bound w*(3;5) >= 76 is classical; only this upper bound is new.)

inputs.expected_cost: about 4.3 CPU-hours with a propagating search split into about 100,000 pieces; make your run resumable, since a restart should cost only the pieces in flight
